name: astrodynamics-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server giving any LLM client authoritative astrodynamics tools — TLE/SGP4, Lambert, ground-station access, time/frame conversions, porkchop, B-plane.
long_description: astrodynamics-mcp exposes eight no-auth astrodynamics tools (tle_lookup, sgp4_propagate, lambert_solve, access_windows, time_convert, frame_transform, porkchop, bplane_target) to any MCP-capable LLM client over stdio. Every result carries explicit units and explicit frame strings; failures surface as typed AstroMCPError envelopes. Tools call vetted upstream libraries (sgp4, lamberthub, skyfield, astropy) and no-auth data sources (CelesTrak, JPL Horizons, IERS).

tools.name: tle_lookup
tools.description: Fetch current TLEs from CelesTrak by NORAD catalog number, name, or group.

tools.name: sgp4_propagate
tools.description: Propagate TLEs across UTC ISO 8601 epochs in TEME / ICRF / GCRS / ITRS / CIRS.

tools.name: lambert_solve
tools.description: Solve Lambert's problem; multi-revolution enumeration and two-impulse Δv on demand.

tools.name: access_windows
tools.description: Ground-station / observer access intervals over a time window, with AOS / LOS / peak elevation.

tools.name: time_convert
tools.description: Convert epochs across UTC, TAI, TT, TDB, UT1, GPS, TCB, TCG in ISO, JD, MJD, J2000-seconds, and Unix.

tools.name: frame_transform
tools.description: Transform state vectors across ICRF, ITRS, GCRS, TEME, CIRS, TIRS, and IAU body-fixed frames.

tools.name: porkchop
tools.description: Compute the (depart × arrive) Δv / C3 grid for interplanetary transfers, with ASCII contour or full output.

tools.name: bplane_target
tools.description: B-plane element calculation and impulsive targeting for hyperbolic flybys.
